text_block_list.text:
I apologize for my tardiness! I left one of
my
books behind, and I had to run back
to get it!
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
No worries. Watch your step when you
board,
there's quite a gap.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I-I will! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text: All right, let's see... One, two, three...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Okay, looks like everyone's here! We're
good to
go, driver!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And with that, this year's summer camp
comes to
an end!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
